Outdoor living

Retractable Awnings in Palm Beach County

Shade on demand for patios and decks. Extend it when you want shade, and retract it when you want sun or when the weather turns.

Get a Free Consultation Call 561-332-8091

We bring samples to your home so you can compare options at your own windows.

Is it a fit?

Where retractable awnings work well

  • Open patios and decks without a roof
  • Cutting heat through nearby windows and doors
  • Flexible shade instead of a permanent structure
  • Outdoor dining and lounge areas
Ask about retractable awnings

Good to know before you choose

Weather
Retract the awning in high wind and storms. Some models offer wind sensors that retract automatically.
Mounting
The wall or roofline has to support the awning. We'll check the mounting surface and the space it needs to extend.
Approvals
Some communities and HOAs require approval for exterior changes. It's worth checking before you order.
How it works

Three steps to finished retractable awnings

  1. Consultation at your home

    We bring samples, look at your windows in real light, and talk through what you need.

  2. Measurement and a written proposal

    Each opening is measured, and you get the products, options, and price in writing.

  3. Installation and walkthrough

    Our own installers fit, adjust, and explain everything before they leave.

Questions

Retractable Awnings questions

Can a retractable awning stay out in the rain?

Light rain is usually fine for short periods if the awning is pitched to shed water. Retract it in heavy rain, wind, and storms.

Manual or motorized?

Both exist. Motorized awnings are easier to use daily and can add sensors. We'll recommend based on size and how often you'll use it.

How far can an awning extend?

It depends on the model and the wall it mounts to. We'll measure and show you how much shade the space can get.
